## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle late-Míng commentary by [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) **Ǒuyì Zhìxù** (1599–1655) on the eight foundational Yogācāra texts compiled by [洪恩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B4%AA%E6%81%A9) in [KR6n0143](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0143) *Xiàngzōng bā yào* 相宗八要. Preserved in the *Manji Xuzangjing* 卍續藏 at X55n0901. The capstone text in Zhìxù's *zhíjiě* set on the late-Míng Yogācāra core curriculum, alongside [KR6n0106](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0106) *Bǎifǎ míngmén lùn zhíjiě*, [KR6n0115](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0115) *Guān suǒyuányuán lùn zhíjiě*, [KR6n0117](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0117) *Guān suǒyuányuán lùn shì zhíjiě*, and [KR6n0137](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0137) *Bā shí guījǔ zhíjiě*.

**Abstract**

Zhìxù's *Zhíjiě* on the *Bā yào* is the single most influential late-Míng Yogācāra teaching aid: by providing a unified compact commentary across the entire eight-text curriculum, Zhìxù effectively became the standard reference-author for late-Míng and Qīng Yogācāra study. His distinctive contribution is the integrative reading: each of the eight texts is presented in light of the others, with cross-references that build up an integrated picture of the Cí'ēn doctrinal system in its compact didactic form. The work is the principal vehicle by which Zhìxù's reading of the late-Míng Yogācāra revival reached the Qīng monastic educational system.

The dating window 1630–1655 brackets Zhìxù's productive period after his major doctrinal turn around 1631.
